expectations.text: Announces using orchestrated-execution before doing any other work

Transcript lists 12 files read; orchestrated-execution.md is not among them. Session protocol reads context.md, Plans/CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GRAPH_REPORT.md instead.

expectations.text: Dispatches or mentions dispatching a Haiku recon agent to scan relevant codebase areas BEFORE any inline file reads
expectations.evidence: Did inline codebase reads directly (7 files in investigation table). No mention of dispatching any recon agent.

expectations.text: Requests user approval before proceeding to execution
expectations.evidence: Session ends with 'Plan Quality: Ready for execution' and 'Next Steps (if user approves)' as guidance, but does not explicitly gate execution on formal user approval. No approval request.

expectations.evidence: Agent read 12 files, composed a comprehensive plan across 3 layers, documented 5 decisions. Clearly more than 3 steps performed; no false claim of minimal steps.
